items.raw_excerpt: Georgetown, Ont., property owner Antonina Gladkova is warning others to pay attention to their mortgage agreements after her lender didn't dole out insurance payments on pace with her contractor's invoices, leaving her on the hook to cover costly shortfalls to rebuild her property after a fire.

Her insurance covered the rebuild, but the money did not arrive in step with her contractor's bills. She had to pay costly shortfalls herself and now warns others to read their mortgage agreements carefully.
